question: How can colored ink washes remain coherent on a freely moving 3D reconstruction?

sources.title: Painterly Rendering for Animation
sources.finding: Attaching brush strokes to 3D surface particles supports spatial and temporal coherence.
sources.adaptation: Seeded deposits use undeformed surface coordinates, with rooted vegetation deformation applied afterward.
sources.notImplemented: The paper's complete particle stroke renderer.

sources.authors: Emil Praun, Hugues Hoppe, Matthew Webb, Adam Finkelstein
sources.title: Real-Time Hatching
sources.finding: Tonal art maps coordinate stroke patterns across tone and resolution.
sources.adaptation: Three cumulative, mipmapped brush maps share earlier marks as density rises; triplanar surface sampling supplies coordinates.
sources.notImplemented: Curvature-aligned lapped surface parameterization and the full published hatching method.

sources.authors: Adrien Bousseau, Matt Kaplan, Joelle Thollot, Francois X. Sillion
sources.title: Interactive Watercolor Rendering with Temporal Coherence and Abstraction
sources.finding: Abstracted color regions can be combined with coherent pigment variation, dry brush and edge effects.
sources.adaptation: Separate broad painted shadows, colored glazes, dry lifts and a small depth-gated edge treatment.
sources.notImplemented: A full watercolor or fluid simulation; this experiment is an optical approximation.

sources.authors: Ming Yan, Jie Wang, Yinghua Shen, Chaohui Lv
sources.title: A non-photorealistic rendering method based on Chinese ink and wash painting style for 3D mountain models
sources.finding: Feature lines, interior wrinkle texture and ink coloring can be treated as distinct mountain-rendering layers.
sources.adaptation: Separate silhouette and cleft ink, surface-following cun ribbons and color wash density.
sources.notImplemented: The paper's curvature extraction, texture quilting, or Gabor dynamic-canvas algorithm.

experiment.sampling: Triplanar undeformed world coordinates, shared across camera poses; derivative-based detail fading and texture mipmaps
experiment.comparison: Same-camera revision 5 versus 6 geometry with held color settings; wash off/on uses the current geometry.
limits: No physical pigment or fluid simulation
Triplanar seams can remain at unusual close angles
Screen contours vary with visibility; surface pigment is the temporally attached component
The reconstruction is still an interpretation, not an exact match

geometryPassNote: Current geometry revised with palette and paint shaders held at revision 5.
